# Workshops

Every piece of work FlightDeck knows about, one line each: a line alone means captured and waiting to start; a folder of the same name means active; a settled: line in its card means settled.

- alpha: plain ask (2026-10-01)
- colon-ask: fix the card: it says "x | y" [sometimes] (and more) (2026-10-02)
- settled-one: a finished piece of work (2026-10-03)
- card-oldest-question: the pre-flight card lists the oldest waiting question first (2026-10-11)
